title: Finite signed-line tensor does not enlarge cohomological support
statement: In the integral line reduction data [def-pur-integral-line-reduction-data], let L be locally free of rank one. For every quotient index n, integer m and unbounded derived finite-coefficient module K, the cohomological support [def-weil-cohomological-support] of finiteOrdinary(L,n,m)(K) is contained in the cohomological support of K. There is no boundedness, completeness or constructibility hypothesis.

proof.text: Identify the actual scalar reduction of L with changeOfRingsOfUniverses using the specified scalarReductionExistence object equation and ScalarHomOrdinary.extensionIso. Scalar extension preserves invertibility; transport it across this isomorphism. Invertibility is equivalent to finite local freeness of rank one. Rewrite finitePower as coefficientTwistLine and apply signedLineTensor_equivalence, obtaining rank one for every signed finite power, including zero and negative exponents.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 0B8N; signed powers and scalar extension

proof.text: For an arbitrary flat module M and the specified closed tensor model S, choose a K-flat resolution P of a complex representing K. The flat-single theorem supplies K-flatness of M[0], exactness of tensorRight M, and the collapse of total tensor with M[0] to termwise tensor. Compose the inverse collapse, the actual S.models.iso and the tensor image of QP isomorphic to K. This gives Q(termwise tensor(P,M)) isomorphic to S.tensor(K,M[0]), with no identification between distinct chosen tensor models needed.

source.place: Tags 06YN and 06YU; K-flat computation of unbounded derived tensor

proof.text: If H^i(K) is zero, transport along QP isomorphic to K and homologyFunctorFactors to show H^i(P) is zero. The exact functor tensorRight M maps this zero object to zero. ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso identifies that image with H^i of termwise tensor. Transport back along homologyFunctorFactors and the tensor isomorphism of step 2. For M the finite signed power, flatness follows from line_unbounded_derived_tensor. Contraposition is precisely the asserted support inclusion.
